notes.subject: נבר
notes.rationale: Tok dispela i stap long Tanakh long hia tasol (o klostu hia tasol); em i olsem ברר — man klia

notes.subject: תתפתל
notes.rationale: Hibru 'yu tanim yuselp / yu pentimap': KJV 'froward', YLT 'wrestler', JPS 'subtle' — ol i no wankain

notes.subject: נבר/תתברר · עקש/תתפתל
notes.rationale: Wankain rot bilong tok i kamap tupela taim; pasin i lus long Tok Pisin

translation: Wantaim man klia, yu soim yuselp klia; na wantaim man i tanim bel, yu tanim pasin bilong yuselp olsem em.
